li.label: a friendly disagreement
li.description: We never see things the same way. It's good to argue it out with someone who listens.

li.label: company in the small hours
li.description: Someone else who's awake when the rest are asleep. The night went quicker with two.

li.label: a fellow under the mountain
li.description: Someone else who likes rock overhead. We could sit in those tunnels all day.

li.label: compared scars
li.description: We showed each other our scars and told the stories. Theirs were nearly as good as mine.

li.label: someone will stand in front
li.description: They said that next time I can stand behind them. I feel a little safer.

li.label: they remembered
li.description: They remembered something I said weeks ago. I didn't think anyone was listening.

li.label: planned a feast
li.description: We planned a whole feast down to the sauces. We'll never cook it, and it was still a good hour.

li.label: a mind to match mine
li.description: We talked about things nobody else here cares about, and they kept up.

li.label: worked late together
li.description: We kept at it after the others stopped. Good to work beside someone who doesn't need telling.

li.label: they steadied me
li.description: I was coming apart, and they stayed calm until I wasn't.

li.label: visited while I was ill
li.description: I felt rotten, and they came by to sit with me for a while.

li.label: sick together
li.description: We're both feeling poorly. Somehow it's easier to complain to someone who knows.

li.label: an old remedy
li.description: They swore by some old cure for what I've got. It might even work.

li.label: welcomed back on my feet
li.description: They were so glad to see me up again. I hadn't known they'd been worried.

li.label: talked over the meeting
li.description: We went over the council meeting again afterward. I understand it better now.

li.label: watched the camp together
li.description: We watched the camp from the wall and made up stories about the people in it.

li.label: said it out loud
li.description: I told someone what's been weighing on me. It isn't gone, but it's lighter.

li.label: trusted with their worries
li.description: They told me what's been keeping them up at night. I'm glad it was me they told.

li.label: thanked again
li.description: They still remember what I did for them, and they made sure I knew it.

li.label: repaid a kindness
li.description: I did something for them in return. It's a start.

li.label: plans for the years ahead
li.description: We talked about what this place could be in ten years. I want to see it.

li.label: that voice
li.description: Their voice goes right through me. I had to say something.

li.label: told to hush
li.description: They asked me to keep it down. I wasn't even being loud.

li.label: gave me a fright
li.description: They crept up on me again, breathing like that. My heart's still going.

li.label: treated like a creep
li.description: They jumped away from me as if I'd done something. I was only standing there.

li.label: keeping an eye on the fire-lover
li.description: Someone has to watch where they put the tinder. Apparently that someone is me.

li.label: not trusted near a fire
li.description: They took the tinderbox off me again, like a child.

li.label: lectured about my things
li.description: They told me I own too much. I'll own what I like, thank you.

li.label: saw more than I wanted to
li.description: Some of us would like to eat without seeing quite so much of a person.

li.label: told to get dressed
li.description: They keep telling me to put more clothes on. My body is my business.

li.label: couldn't agree on a pace
li.description: We tried to walk somewhere together. One of us was too fast and one too slow.

li.label: argued about implants
li.description: We argued about machine parts and what makes a person. Neither of us moved an inch.

li.label: treated like I'm catching
li.description: I'm ill, not cursed. They moved away from me at the table.

li.label: argued about the camp
li.description: We argued about the people camped on our land. They're wrong about them.

li.label: snapped at
li.description: They bit my head off over nothing. Whatever's eating them, it wasn't me.
